meta_data.base_class: Find the latest updates or patches for a specific game on the <video game platform> platform - refers to a dedicated gaming hardware platform such as PlayStation or Xbox that has its own game distribution and pricing system.

tool_template.name: <class>.update.find
tool_template.description: Find the latest updates or patches for a specific game on the <class> platform.

game.description: The name of the game for which to find updates on the <class> platform.

region.description: The region of the update on the <class> platform. e.g., US, EU, JP.

release_start_date.description: The start date (inclusive) of the time range during which the update was released on the <class> platform, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

release_end_date.description: The end date (inclusive) of the time range during which the update was released on the <class> platform, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

changelog_required.description: Indicates if the changelog of the update are required for the <class>.

update_type.description: The type of update to find for the <class>, such as 'security', 'feature', or 'bug fix'.
